title: Assembly Issues and Won't Stay Mounted
text:
Assembly Issues and Won't Stay Mounted. My wife has been after me to hang up a paper power holder for a while and this looked like a good one that would fill the need we have. Unfortunately we have encountered a couple of issues with it. In a nutshell, we’ve have an assembly issue and the thing just will not stay mounted.

Right out of the box, the bar where the paper towel roll goes was loose – very loose. There are two screws that attach this bar to the rest of the assembly, and one of them had worked loose. Not a big deal, it’s easy enough to tighten. However, it loosened up again and I had to tighten it a second time. This is no good.

Mounting this holder involves using the sticky pads and either glue or double sided tape to attach it to the surface where it is to be mounted. In theory this is a good approach, but in practice there are some issues. I have been trying for several days to mount it on a glossy tile surface in my kitchen, and it just will not stay attached. I have tried multiple types of double-sided tape, including one brand that is rated to handle up to 30 pounds, and it still pulls away from the holder (it sticks to the tile just fine).

For the moment, it sits on its end on the counter. That’s not a particularly useful way to get the paper towel roll off the counter and out of the way.
